evidence.requirements: Nearly everything in the brief is met. The list has the heading, the name links, family and L3, Search, the Family select and '<n> cartridges' (app.js:28-72). Search covers alternative names; '7,62 x 51' finds 308 Win. (format.js:106-114). The detail view has every metadata field and the water capacity with its source link (format.js:116-133). Tables have Symbol/Value/Unit and tolerances sit beside the value ('39.62 -0.2', detail-308_win.jpg). Print and All cartridges buttons exist, and the #/cartridge/<key> address survives a reload. The SVG is drawn at 1 unit = 1 mm with an outside view, a hatched section, a dash-dot centre line and a title block that includes the scale. Missing values get 'Not drawn: …' notes (geometry.js:90-95). Print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg). Partly met: (1) the shoulder angle α is a single leader with one arrowhead (layout.js:81-84), not a dimension with extension lines and an arc. (2) Units are 'deg' next to values that already carry '°'. Not verifiable from the screenshots: phone width (only covered by an e2e test).
evidence.correctness: The geometry follows the rules closely. Chamfer: geometry.js:183-187. Rimfire half-round with radius min(R/2,(R1-P1)/2), outermost point at R1/2: lines 174-181. Groove and belt ramp at δ: lines 200-216. Shoulder through the published points with r1 min / r2 fillets: lines 234-251. Seating factors s and k, tangent-ogive radius and centre, quarter-ellipse nose and cone noses all match the formulas (lines 108-149). Heeled 22 LR shows the case OD outside and H2-2·tb as the heel (lines 114-131, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). Walls: tn/tb formulas, primer pocket table, and w (lines 257-272). Outlines and proportions match the reference drawings for 308 Win, 300 WM (belt visible), 9 mm Luger (round nose) and 22 LR (rounded rim). Every dimension value matches the data. Weak points: α is not drawn as an angle. On straight cases the inner wall is blended over one seating depth, a documented interpretation (SPEC.md:37-39). The screen scale is nominal (96 dpi).
evidence.security: All DOM is built with createElement, setAttribute and textContent (app.js:7-20; drawing.js:42-48). There is no innerHTML and no eval. The only external URL is the record's capacity link, opened with rel=noopener noreferrer (app.js:80). An e2e test asserts there are no network requests (app.test.js:269-277).
evidence.code_quality: Clear separation into data, format, geometry (pure), layout (pure), drawing and app (router), all shared by Node and the browser through a UMD wrapper. Names are good and comments are short. Errors are handled: a missing required value gives 'Cannot draw', a malformed URI gives Not found. Weak points: the label layout uses an iterative-deepening DFS (layout.js:42-67), which is heavier than needed, and geometry.build is one ~210-line function. The skip link ('#main') collides with the hash router, a design oversight (index.html:11 vs app.js:172-184).
evidence.tests: The unit tests cover each geometry rule 1-9 with real records and edge cases: rebated threshold, chamfer cap, tangent-ogive arc radius, quarter ellipse, heeled bullet, walls, pockets, w, and missing-value notes. They also cover formatting, units, tolerances and search (geometry.test.js, format.test.js). Playwright tests run under file:// and http. They check the list, search and filter, Back behaviour, reload, the accessible name, true scale for all 25, label overlap using real getBBox/isPointInStroke for all 25, print colours, and a PDF page count of 1 for all 25 (app.test.js). Gaps: nothing tests the skip link, which is broken; nothing checks how α is drawn; there is no visual or dark-mode check beyond background luminance.
evidence.ux_design: Dense, calm data-sheet look. The meta grid is compact and value tables are grouped by section in four columns with mono, tabular numbers (detail-308_win.jpg). Drawing labels are legible and do not overlap. However, the title block is set larger than the dimension labels and takes about a third of the drawing area. On 9 mm Luger, 22 LR and 44 Rem. Mag. it outweighs the cartridge itself, because the viewBox has a 100 mm minimum (layout.js:13,129). Some labels nearly touch ('R1 7.06P1 5.74' in detail-22_long_rifle.jpg; 'R1 13.35 P1 11.9' in detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg). Two source footers stack on screen. The print layout is good: header, full-width drawing, four-column tables, fixed footer (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.accessibility: Good: the SVG has role=img with aria-label '<name> drawing' and a <title>. Tables use caption and th scope. Search and Family have proper labels, the count uses role=status with aria-live, focus moves to the h1 on route change, there is a :focus-visible outline, and muted-text contrast is adequate. Problems: the 'Skip to content' link points to '#main'. The hash router reads that as a path and replaces the page with 'Not found' (index.html:11, app.js:172-184), so the one keyboard aid breaks the page. The drawing's text alternative is only the name; the tables do carry the values.
evidence.simplicity: Plain HTML/CSS/JS with no runtime dependencies and Playwright as the only dev dependency (package.json). About 1000 lines of app code, which fits the geometry. The layout branch-and-bound search and the label-overlap machinery are more elaborate than strictly needed.
evidence.maintainability: Good: README with open, serve and test instructions (README.md); SPEC.md records interpretations and decisions; package-lock.json is present; there are regression tests for every rule; app modules carry header comments. Missing: no CI pipeline, no Node version pin (.nvmrc or engines) even though the brief says Node 22, no ADRs, no changelog or release approach beyond version 1.0.0. The Playwright system-deps step is mentioned but not scripted.
evidence.visual_design: Consistent neutral palette, a blue accent for dimensions, mono numerals, and clean thin table rules. The drawing looks technical, with a beige bullet, hatched cut and blue dimension lines (detail-300_win_mag.jpg). Two things look unfinished: the oversized bold title block, whose font is bigger than every label, and the large empty area to the right of small cartridges. Dark mode is defined in CSS but not shown in any screenshot.
evidence.layout: The page order is logical: heading and actions, meta, drawing, tables, footer. On small cartridges the drawing sits in the left 40% of a wide frame with the title block dominating the lower right, and much of the frame is empty space (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). Label gaps are very small in places. The tables grid is tidy but leaves ragged empty cells. Print uses the page well, with no clipping (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.usability: Navigation is short: the list links to the detail view, with Print and All cartridges as buttons. Search filters as you type and tolerates commas, points and spaces. The filter state is kept in the hash, so Back restores it. Unknown or malformed addresses get a Not found page with a way back. Missing-feature notes explain gaps in the drawing. Keyboard users lose the page if they use the skip link.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would find it trustworthy. Values are as published, tolerances sit beside them, the drawings are true to scale and visibly faithful to the C.I.P. outlines, and the one-page print works. The heavy title block and the α leader instead of a proper angle dimension lower the polish slightly for engineers.

unmet_requirements: Shoulder angle α is shown only as a leader with one arrowhead (layout.js:81-84), not as an angle dimension with extension lines
Angle unit column shows 'deg' redundantly beside values formatted '40°' (format.js:59)
Labels 'do not overlap' is met technically, but some labels nearly touch, e.g. 'R1 7.06P1 5.74' (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg)
strengths: Geometry implements rules 1-9 faithfully: chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove and belt ramp at δ, filleted shoulder, ogive and ellipse noses, heeled 22 LR, walls, primer pocket and w. Outlines match the OpenBallistics references at true scale.
Strong test suite: unit tests per drawing rule, plus Playwright checks of real label overlap, true scale and a one-page A4 PDF for all 25 cartridges, under both file:// and http.
Clean, dependency-free code with pure geometry and layout modules, safe DOM building, and a well-executed print sheet (header, full-width drawing, four-column tables, footer).
issues: The 'Skip to content' link (href '#main') is read by the hash router as a route and replaces the page with 'Not found' (index.html:11, app.js:172-184). It breaks the main keyboard aid, and no test catches it.
The oversized title block and the 100 mm minimum viewBox make the title block outweigh short cartridges (9 mm, 22 LR, 44 Mag.), leave large empty areas, and push some labels almost together.
The α angle is drawn as a bare leader instead of an angle dimension. The repo has no CI pipeline and no Node version pin.
review.verdict: This is a careful, well-tested build: the computed drawings follow the brief's geometry rules, match the reference outlines at true scale, and print on one A4 page. The broken skip link, the oversized title block on short cartridges and the leader-only α dimension should be fixed before publishing.
